svg.aria-label: Comic: each node is a program with one job; the lidar node publishes messages in a /scan mailbox; every message on /scan is a LaserScan; a map node and Foxglove both read from /scan while the lidar has no idea who reads its messages
svg.title: Nodes, topics and messages, as a comic
svg.text: Each node is a program that does one job.
The lidar publishes on a named topic: /scan.
Every message on /scan has the same type.
Anyone can read it. The lidar never knows who.
